attractions.name: Maya Bay
attractions.description: One of Thailand's most iconic beaches, with towering limestone cliffs and powdery white sand. Famous from the movie The Beach.

attractions.name: Pileh Lagoon
attractions.description: Also called the Emerald Lagoon, an inlet surrounded by towering cliffs with crystal-clear water. One of the most picturesque spots in the Phi Phi islands.

attractions.name: Viking Cave
attractions.description: Cave famous for ancient wall paintings and for bird nest harvesting used in traditional Thai bird's nest soup. Boats usually stop nearby for viewing and photographs.

attractions.name: Monkey Beach
attractions.description: Beach with playful wild monkeys often seen near the shoreline. The surrounding waters are good for snorkeling.
tips: Do not feed or approach the monkeys too closely
